definitions.explanation: Having many bright colors. Used to describe objects, designs, clothing, and scenes that are visually vibrant.

examples.japanese: カラフルな{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
{子|こ}どもたちがカラフルな{絵|え}を{描|か}いた。
マーケットにはカラフルな{野菜|やさい}や{果物|くだもの}がずらりと{並|なら}んでいた。
examples.english: Colorful vegetables and fruits were lined up in rows at the market.

notes:
カラフル is a na-adjective from English 'colorful,' meaning having many bright, vivid colors. It always carries a positive nuance.

FORMS:
- カラフルな〜: colorful (modifier)
- カラフルに: colorfully (adverb)
- カラフルだ: is colorful (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カラフルな{色合|いろあ}い: colorful palette
- カラフルな{衣装|いしょう}: colorful costume
- カラフルなデザイン: colorful design
- カラフルな{花|はな}: colorful flowers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {色鮮|いろあざ}やか: vivid in color (more literary)
- {派手|はで}: flashy, gaudy (can be negative)
- カラーの: colored (as opposed to black-and-white)

カラフル implies cheerful brightness. For gaudy or garish colors, use {派手|はで} instead.
